summary: OS Therapies Inc filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $75 million of common stock through Jefferies as sales agent. The filing is a routine shelf takedown under an existing S-3 registration, not a special situation. The closing price was $1.58 per share on August 20, 2026. Jefferies will receive 3.0% commission. No escrow arrangement. This is ordinary capital-raising, not a transformative event; no special-situation category applies.
